name: TikTok

disclosure.zh: 发布前请在「更多选项」里打开「AI 生成内容」开关（内容含 AI 生成或明显修改的画面/声音时必须标注）。检查「谁可以看」与评论/合拍设置。
disclosure.en: Before posting, turn on "AI-generated content" under "Show more" when the video contains AI-generated or significantly edited images or audio. Check "Who can watch" and the comment / duet settings.

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written without a logged-in session): check them on the live page and set status to verified + lastVerified.
The caption field appears only after the video starts uploading; the fill waits up to 60 s for it.
TikTok pre-fills the caption with the file name; clear=true replaces it.
Cover (thumbnail) is chosen in TikTok's own editor: done by hand.
